summary.zh: 用你的飞书账号登录，让模型读取你的飞书文档和群消息（只读，每次读取都会询问）。需要 lark-cli。
summary.en: Sign in with your Feishu account so the model can read your docs and group chats (read-only; every read asks first). Needs lark-cli.

summary.zh: 评审清单加 /review 命令：按正确性、边界、安全、测试分级给意见。
summary.en: A review checklist plus /review: feedback graded by correctness, edge cases, security and tests.

summary.zh: /commit-msg 写提交信息，/pr-desc 写 PR 描述，先参考仓库已有的风格。
summary.en: /commit-msg writes commit messages and /pr-desc writes PR descriptions, following the repo's style.

summary.zh: 周报、会议纪要、润色、翻译四个命令。
summary.en: Weekly report, meeting minutes, polishing and translation commands.

summary.zh: /debug：先复现、再缩小范围、确认根因后才改代码。
summary.en: /debug: reproduce first, narrow down, and only change code once the root cause is confirmed.

summary.zh: /sql 写和解释 SQL，/sql-tune 分析慢查询；不连接任何数据库。
summary.en: /sql writes and explains SQL, /sql-tune analyses slow queries; never connects to a database.

summary.zh: 一个技能加一个 /hello 命令，用来熟悉插件怎么用。
summary.en: A skill plus a /hello command, to get familiar with plugins.

summary.zh: 最小的 MCP 工具插件，演示配置表单、状态检查和操作按钮（需要 python3）。
summary.en: A minimal MCP tool plugin showing the settings form, status check and actions (needs python3).
